hostStep.running: Installing Docker and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit; this takes a few minutes, and the installation continues by itself.

reboot.title: Reinicia el equipo
reboot.body: WSL está activado y Windows necesita reiniciarse para terminar. Tras el reinicio, abre Atomic Chat: la instalación continuará sola, sin volver a pedir permiso.

phaseWindows.preparing-environment: Configurando la distribución WSL de Atomic Chat y comprobando que ve tu GPU

bar.hostStep: Approve the system password prompt. After that, Docker and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit are installed; this can take a few minutes, and the installation continues by itself.
bar.hostStepWindows: Approve the Windows administrator prompt (UAC). After that, Windows downloads and installs WSL; this takes several minutes with no window of its own, and the installation continues by itself.
bar.reboot: WSL is turned on. Restart Windows to finish; after the restart, open Atomic Chat and the installation continues by itself.
bar.relogin: You were added to the docker group. Sign out and sign back in for it to take effect; then open Atomic Chat and the installation continues by itself.
bar.actionFailed: Could not do it from here ({{error}}). Do it yourself; the installation continues afterwards.
